summary: The client called because their router stopped working overnight and they suspect the issue was caused by a previous setup or movement of the equipment. The agent initially suggested fault with the client’s actions but ultimately stated that the system malfunctioned on its own, leading to a replacement being required. After investigating, the agent confirmed the customer is responsible for the faulty equipment and will proceed with replacing it.

ratings.name: Branding and Survey
ratings.reason: The agent used the standard greeting and offered a post-call survey.

ratings.name: Personalized the Call
ratings.reason: – The agent correctly addressed the customer by name ("You").

ratings.name: Empathy and Acknowledgment
ratings.reason: – The agent acknowledged the customer’s frustration with the router failure, stating “This doesn't just break…”

ratings.name: Rapport and Professionalism
ratings.reason: The agent maintained a calm tone and avoided defensive language. [RoBERTa flagged 1 harsh agent line(s)]

ratings.name: Paraphrasing
ratings.reason: – The agent restated the customer’s issue ("Your router stopped working overnight.")

ratings.name: Verified Customer
ratings.reason: – The agent validated the customer’s name and account details.

ratings.name: Probing
ratings.reason: – The agent asked clarifying questions about when the problem started (“When did you first notice this?”).

ratings.name: Set Proper Expectations
ratings.reason: The agent offered a potential solution (replacement) but didn't immediately escalate.

ratings.name: Provided the Solution
ratings.reason: – The agent suggested a replacement router, which is a logical next step.

ratings.name: Took Ownership
ratings.reason: – The agent acknowledged responsibility ("If you broke it…").

ratings.name: Active Listening
ratings.reason: – The agent listened to the customer’s explanation without interruption.

ratings.name: Confirmed Resolution
ratings.reason: The agent confirmed that the replacement router was offered and initiated.

suggestions: The client wants a router replaced due to faulty equipment.
They believe the issue was caused by an incorrect setup by a technician.
Verify the client’s rental agreement for details about equipment responsibility.
Check if there are any recent changes in the client's home environment that could have triggered this (e.g., new devices).
